newsitem.title: USA: Selling fever abates for US crudes in even session.
newsitem.headline: Selling fever abates for US crudes in even session.

text.p: Prices for U.S. cash and paper crudes moderated Thursday on a spate of technical buying in the futures market and consolidation in cash grades.
Traders said the most prominent feature in a relatively steady day was the extension of the May/June West Texas Intermediate Cushing spread, which remained in contango.

Usually the values for each crude month fall in order from highest prices to weakest, or backwardation. In recent sessions that has changed as bearish fundamental oversupply prompted a sell-off in the front May WTI, to the benefit of the June, where the second month now holds a 7-12 cents edge.
